Cross-modal structure is compatible with positive RNA/CNV silhouettes and consistently positive fused boundary separation from all other sets. Confounder testing shows no set-specific technical association, and the partition shows negligible stage/grade overlap. Retained as a defensible discovery-stage candidate.

Cross-modal structure is compatible with positive RNA/WSI/CNV silhouettes and positive fused boundaries to all other sets. No set-specific technical confounder was detected. Retained for downstream validation.

This unresolved confounder caveat is carried forward as uncertainty, but the strong coherent BAP1 identity evidence supports retaining the candidate for downstream validation.

No set-specific technical confounder was detected. Retained as a defensible discovery-stage candidate.

C0005 shows only weak biological evidence: no significant findings in any modality after adjustment, with a suggestive but nonsignificant VHL-high/PBRM1-low mutation pattern. Cross-modal structure is compatible, driven by a strong WXS silhouette (0.586) with positive fused boundaries to all other sets, and no set-specific technical confounder was detected. The weak identity signal is an unresolved limitation, but the compatible structure and absence of a competing explanation support retaining this candidate for downstream validation rather than dropping it.
